[
  {
    "id": "houserules.template-is-the-source",
    "kind": "rule",
    "area": "global",
    "standing": true,
    "summary": "Edit the kit in `template/`, then run `node bin/houserules.mjs update --dir .`; never hand-edit the root copies or the generated rules and skill.",
    "body": [
      "This repository runs its own kit. The root copies of every `KIT_OWNED` path — `tools/`, `.claude/agents/`, and the kit skills — are the installed copy; `template/` is the source that `init` and `update` ship to every project.",
      "`tests/dogfood.test.mjs` pins every root copy to its template source byte for byte; a hand edit fails the test and is lost on the next update.",
      "`.claude/rules/*.md` and `.claude/skills/project-knowledge/SKILL.md` are generated by `tools/kb.sh render` from `knowledge/`."
    ],
    "tags": [
      "dogfood",
      "template",
      "update"
    ],
    "source": {
      "date": "2026-08-31",
      "by": "user",
      "ref": "docs/design.md §5.5"
    },
    "verify": [
      "tests/dogfood.test.mjs",
      "bin/houserules.mjs"
    ],
    "topic": "houserules"
  }
]
